title: Build it, break it on purpose, then hand it over

say: Build it, break it on purpose, then hand it over.
This is the video for module two of Automation with Zapier and Make.
In this module you build a real Zap. Every time someone fills a Google Form, they get a confirmation email.

say: A safety point about money. Fraudsters copy business names and send fake account numbers. So keep payment details in one place the owner controls, and check every automated message that mentions money.
Grace's email says payment details will come on WhatsApp from her known business number.

panel.heading: Keep payment details safe
left: Keep payment details in one place
Send them from a known number

say: Never let customer-typed text decide where money is paid.

say: Test on purpose with bad data. Try blank fields, phone numbers typed different ways, names with apostrophes, and a customer who submits twice.

cards.d: Blank fields, phone numbers typed different ways, odd names, the same customer submitting twice.
Remove a connection on purpose. Check that the error is recorded and a person is alerted.
In Make, store incomplete executions so a failed run can be retried, not lost.

say: Test a failure too. Make, by default, switches off a scheduled scenario after 3 errors in a row. So send error alerts to you and to a named person at the client.

cards.d: Blank fields, phone numbers typed different ways, odd names, the same customer submitting twice.
Remove a connection on purpose. Check that the error is recorded and a person is alerted.
In Make, store incomplete executions so a failed run can be retried, not lost.

say: For example, Chidinma's enrolment scenario stopped when the admin changed a Google password. Musa saw the alert that morning. She reconnected, retried the stored runs, and all 9 waiting enrolments went through.

say: Tick every box before you hand over. The normal case passes. Edge cases are handled or flagged. Failure alerts reach a person.
Personal data is kept to what each step needs. Nigeria has the Nigeria Data Protection Act 2023, so build in the client's own accounts and remove your access at the end.
And the run book is written and shared.

panel.heading: Ready for real use?
items: Normal case passes
Edge cases handled or flagged
Failure alerts reach a person
Personal data minimised
Run book written and shared

say: To remember. Keep the trigger sheet clean. Test with a real submission. Give every router a fallback. Send error alerts to a real person. And write a one-page run book: what it does, which accounts it uses, how to tell it works, and who to call.

panel.heading: Remember
items: Keep the trigger sheet clean and headers unchanged
Test the trigger with a real submission
Every router needs a fallback route
Send error alerts to a real person
A one-page run book lets the client run it
